description: This file defines a report parser class for budget reports in an Odoo module, including methods to calculate totals and retrieve account line data.

classes.name: budget_report
classes.description: A report parser class for generating budget reports, providing methods to compute totals and retrieve account data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates local context with methods and variables.

methods.name: post_total
methods.description: Calculates previous and achievement totals over a date interval for a given post object.

methods.name: budget_total
methods.description: Aggregates total budget data based on post object and date range.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Retrieves account move line achievements for each account within a date range.
